title: Hotel Palliser: Calgary ka Haunted Castle 🇨🇦
hook_line: Canada ke ek grand hotel mein kuch aisi cheezein hoti hain jo guests aur staff ko aaj bhi darati hain.
caption:
Canada ka ek aisa hotel jise 'Haunted Castle' kaha jata hai. 🇨🇦

Hotel Palliser ki deewaron mein aaj bhi kuch rahasya chupe hain jo guests aur staff ko darate hain. Kya aap yahan rukne ki himmat karenge?
Follow for more international mysteries.
meaning_note: Ye video Canada ke Hotel Palliser par focus karta hai, jo apni haunting history aur paranormal reports ki wajah se 'Haunted Castle' ke naam se jana jata hai.
